summary: Silver Bow Mining Corp. filed an 8-K reporting an October 2, 2026 Note Purchase Agreement with Ocean Partners UK Limited for a $5.0 million secured promissory note priced at par, maturing March 31, 2027, bearing SOFR plus 6.75%, payable monthly from November 1, 2026. The note is secured by a first-priority interest in a $28.58 million MTGF note tied to the pending Montana Tunnels Complex acquisition. If that acquisition closes before maturity, principal and interest are credited against a concentrate prepayment facility; otherwise a lump sum is due. Also disclosed: an officer departure.
